name: Hanamaru! 2
source:
Aoi lives a peaceful life. His school actively accepts students of different species and the city is famous for it. One day, he remembers his dream that he wanted to be a hero like a superman when he was a kid. The next morning, the noise wakes him up, coming from his desk. When he opens the drawer, a girl is inside....

[From ErogeShop]
